test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 03
subject: general
question: Which healthcare institution has been officially recognised as India's first "Zero Waste to Landfill" model under the Swachh Bharat Mission Urban 2.0?

options.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS)
National Institute of Tuberculosis and Respiratory Diseases (NITRD)
National Institute of Mental Health and Neurosciences (NIMHANS)
Post Graduate Institute of Medical Education and Research (PGIMER)

solution:
The correct answer is __**National Institute of Tuberculosis and Respiratory Diseases (NITRD)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The **National Institute of Tuberculosis and Respiratory Diseases (NITRD)** has become India's first **"Zero Waste to Landfill"** healthcare model under **Swachh Bharat Mission Urban 2.0**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **NITRD**, operating under the **Ministry of Health and Family Welfare**, is the first healthcare institution to achieve full compliance in the **Bulk Waste Generator category** under the **2026 Solid Waste Management Guidelines**.
 
• The initiative was executed by the **Why Waste Wednesdays Foundation** through its flagship program, **Swachh Sankalp**.
 
• The 27-acre campus generates approximately **1 to 1.2 tons of waste daily**, including 500-650 kgs of wet waste, which is now entirely managed through on-ground infrastructure.
 
• The project established a **Wet Waste Composting Centre**, a **Dry Waste Resource Centre**, and **Dedicated Horticulture Waste Management Systems** to ensure maximum recovery and diversion from landfills.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The South Zone team of the **Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD)** inaugurated **40 Aerobin (Gaia) composting units** and two horticulture waste shredders at NITRD in Mehrauli Ward.
 
• An intensive awareness campaign comprising nearly **50 customised sessions** was conducted for hospital staff, administrators, and support personnel to foster a culture of environmental accountability.
 
• A dedicated monitoring station and consumables management space were established to oversee operations in real-time.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• This zero-waste ecosystem at **NITRD** serves as a national benchmark, demonstrating that sustainable, large-scale healthcare operations are feasible without compromising patient care under the **Swachh Bharat Mission Urban 2.0**.
